english.title: Worker knowingly allow consumption on relevant premises of alcohol by under 18
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person working whether paid or unpaid,on relevant premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES AND LOCATION..), in a capacity which authorised you to prevent it, knowingly allowed **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..) an individual under the age of 18, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AGE..), to consume alcohol, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ALCOHOL..), on those premises
english.legislation: Contrary to section 150(2), (3)(a) and (5)(b) of the Licensing Act 2003.

english.notes:
As from 08/04/2013 Penalty Notices for Disorder may ONLY be issued to offenders aged 18 years or over.

This offence may be disposed of by the issue of a Penalty Notice for Disorder - DB13

(i) The Penalty Notice for Disorder was raised from £50 to £60 as from 1/07/13.
(ii) Section 150(4) of the Licensing Act 2003 provides that the above offence does not apply where:-
(a) the individual is aged 16 or 17,
(b) the alcohol is beer, wine or cider,
(c) its consumption is at a table meal on relevant premises, and (d) the individual is accompanied at the meal by an individual aged 18 or over.
(iii) Fingerprints, photographs and DNA samples may be taken from an individual where he/she is subject to arrest and the Penalty Notice is issued at a police station.
